metadata.title: भगोरिया की 5 ज़रूरी बातें | 5 Facts about Bhagoriya | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Bhagoriya 2025 is a vibrant festival celebrated by the Bhil and Bhilala tribes in Madhya Pradesh, India, just before Holi. The event is marked by lively singing, spirited dancing, and festive revelry. Know 5 facts about this colourful festival.
